root_cause: After successful deletion of stale watchdog scheduled task Phase4C2G_Emergency_Network_Recovery, read-back query via schtasks.exe /query returned non-zero exit code and native stderr 'ERROR: The system cannot find the file specified.' Under $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop' in Windows PowerShell 5.1, native stderr was escalated into a terminating RemoteException (FullyQualifiedErrorId: NativeCommandError) at line 426, prematurely stopping the controller before watchdog creation or adapter isolation.
hotfix: Created Test-ScheduledTaskExists and Remove-ScheduledTaskSafely helpers using ScheduledTasks module (Get-ScheduledTask / Unregister-ScheduledTask) with safe try/finally $ErrorActionPreference handling for schtasks.exe fallback. Prevents native stderr from escalating into a terminating exception on query or deletion.
